[SWS_DM_00958] Default value for DTC "aging counter up" if aging is not al-
lowed
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the element
DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.aging
does not exist and the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
DiagnosticEdrDat-
aProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticEdrDat-
aProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT
, the DM shall
set the respective
extended data record
value to ’0’.
⌋
